title: オーネストなセールスで！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from a day out with Seeking the Pearl, we come across a street vendor.

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Welcome, welcome! Come and check out my wares! These extremely rare aurora hanadama necklaces are made with genuine akoya pearls!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: They're incredibly rare even among hanadama pearls! And look at their size! For a limited time only, I'm willing to part with them at a thirty percent discount, so they're only 100,000 yen apiece!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: Why, did you say akoya pearls?! Never in my days did I think I'd come across some here of all places! I'll take this one!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh wow, what craftsmanship! These are all so exquisitely made!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh my, are you interested in these pieces too?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, yes, they're absolutely fascinating! This shimmer, this luster… Every accessory on display has clearly been very carefully handled!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: You've got a well trained eye, miss! Yes, everything you see here was made from precious, natural resou—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: They're the highest quality imitation pearls I've seen yet! A lot of care was put into them, that's for sure!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Ack! Um! No! These are…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that I think about it, Seeking the Pearl's father was a jeweler. If she says they're imitation pearls, then they must be fakes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The stunningly high-end finish on them is really something else. The surface texture is so consistent, and you can really feel their heft.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And since they're imitation pearls, they won't get dirty or damaged easily, making them good for everyday use.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? Sounds like they're quite versatile indeed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yep! Their affordability makes it easy to elevate your fashion with fancy jewelry that looks just like the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What a commendable heart! You're a true friend of the people!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I absolutely love what you're doing here! Though, it's a shame they're only knockoffs…

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Um… ah, no, I… Well…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You should tailor your business to better suit the needs of your customers! As a friend of the masses, you should properly explore the possibilities of imitation fashion!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Th-the possibilities of imitation fashion? The needs of the people…

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: I see now. I've been wrong. Why did I ever try to scam people into believing these were real?

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Ma'am! Allow me to adjust the price of that necklace! I'm reducing it down to 1,500 yen!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! Now how about this for your pitch? "Mind-bogglingly low prices! Imitation pearl accessories that'll make anyone dazzle with effortless ease!"

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's great! Forget scamming people! I'm going to become a true friend of the people and make honest coin out of my wares from now on!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: I think I will take this necklace after all. It's really quite a steal for the quality. And it'll make all my friends so jealous!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. Now that's what makes imitation accessories so appealing. We should spread the word somehow. What do you think would be the best way to promote it?
choice_data_list: Highlight the unique features of imitation jewelry!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That makes sense… there are a lot of students in the area. I'm sure a lot of them would love a fancy new accessory on a budget!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey there, girls! How about trying out some imitation pearl accessories? Indulge in some high-class fashion at minimal cost!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huh, pearls? Are they actually that affordable? My allowance isn't that big…

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text: Wow! There's loads of cute ones! They've even got earrings for just 500 yen!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wait, are those pearls?! Look at this bracelet! It's so bougie!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! They're a total a hit, just like we were hoping! I see a pearl craze on the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the street vendor's store flourishes thanks to word-of-mouth among students.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Good idea. I suppose we could talk up how versatile they are.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's try to develop a new product!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: How about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Simply amazing! It'll sell like hotcakes, no doubt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Seeking the Pearl's creativity and the street vendor's craftsmanship, the two create flower-shaped beads with the imitation pearls.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just change the fittings, and you've got an unparalleled four-in-one accessory that can be worn as a necklace, earring, brooch, or keychain!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: My goodness! How wonderful! I'll take that one too!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: R-right away, ma'am! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: Teehee. I really lucked out on all the bargains I nabbed today. I'm going to tell my neighbors all about this place! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, seems like we have a satisfied customer! Let's keep it up and win over even more people!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey there, everyone! Check out our super unique four-in-one fashion pearls! They're affordable, stylish, and super versatile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after, the four-in-one imitation pearl accessories surge in popularity thanks to the first customer spreading the word, and they quickly becoming the street vendor's top-selling item.
